'''Lichtenstein''' was Decipher's internal code-name for a gameplay mechanic planned for the cancelled character-themed expansions [[Skywalkers (expansion)|Skywalkers]], [[Jedi Masters]], and [[Scoundrels]].

Instead of printing new versions of Luke, Leia, Vader, Yoda, Obi-Wan, the Emperor, Han, Lando, Boba Fett, or Jabba, Lichtenstein cards would have granted new capabilities to existing character cards already in the pool.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref><ref name="after">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050307015419/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/whatisit/afterdeathstar.html After Death Star II] at Decipher.com (archive, 7 March 2005)</ref>

The mechanic never reached a retail set. Episode I expansions replaced that schedule after Lucasfilm asked Decipher to mix ''The Phantom Menace'' into the original-trilogy game.
